text:
morgan: Morning check-in (quick):
- what I did: landed kernel prefetch patch (PR #432), ran a couple microbench runs on batch=8/seq=1024. Saw ~6-8% avg latency improvement and p95 tightened slightly.
- blocker: hit a rare OOM when kv warmup + eviction happen during very long contexts (~32k). Need to add a guard in the warmup path.
- today: iterate on eviction heuristics, add a unit test to repro OOM, follow up w/ CI perf job. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/432 :rocket:

alex: Nice work — can you paste the bench command + raw numbers?

morgan: sure, pasted the run below:
```
./bench --model=redwood-3b --batch=8 --seq=1024 --iters=100
avg_latency_ms: 45.2
p95_latency_ms: 78.3
throughput_tok_s: 12000
```

tess: FYI I observed a similar p95 bump on canary last night. Suspect slot-stealing during heavy eviction windows. I can add more tracing for slot handoffs (low overhead).

sam: Quick q — is the OOM deterministic or only under slot churn? If deterministic please attach the logs from the failing run.

morgan: only happens in bursty evictions; sketch of log line: `runtime: evicting 12 entries -> mem spike -> allocate failed` . I'll push a small repro harness to the branch shortly.

riley: Left two nits on the PR (naming + a docstring). Also requested adding a lightweight perf-check in CI: `./ci/perf-check.sh --ref=main --head=pr-432`. That way we catch regressions before rollout.

deploy-bot: Deployed canary (prefetch=on) to us-west with 2 instances at 09:12 UTC. Monitoring: https://console.redwood.ai/canaries/432 :white_check_mark:

alex: Blocker for me — reproducing queueing on a dedicated cluster when batch sizes >32. Might be related to batching slot allocation; will pair with @morgan later today.

tess: Today I'm adding unit tests around eviction margins and wiring histogram alerts for p95 increases.

morgan: thanks all. I'll write a short design note in #eng-runtime-kernel and create the CI perf job. If anyone wants to pair on the repro @alex @tess :coffee:
